key_insight: The paper shows that commonly used continuity equations in Generalised Lagrangian Mean theory are incomplete unless extra compatibility conditions are added, and it generalizes the MAT framework to arbitrary fluid motion.
engineering_relevance: For turbulence and multiphase or perturbed-flow modeling, this clarifies when mean-flow continuity forms are mathematically valid and helps prevent incorrect mass-conservation implementations.
method: Derive the actual velocity divergence in terms of the averaged velocity divergence.
Formulate three exact continuity-equation variants and identify what each omits.
Restore validity by adding compatibility equations and compare them with original and generalized MAT formulations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a purely analytical study using exact formulae and general fluid-dynamic statements, without motion equations or numerical evaluation.
watch_item: The generalized continuity forms still depend on the correct compatibility conditions, so applying them without checking those assumptions can make the model invalid.
paper_title: Continuity equations in the Generalised Lagrangian Mean theory
